snippet.title: NITRO GEN OMEGA - Early Access Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: A Spaghetti Anime turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a crew of mercenaries through wastelands overrun by ruthless machines. Engage in high-octane cinematic Mech battles, recruit pilots and grow relationships. Play solo or join an online world where every character is procedurally generated.
